brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Candidal balanitis, cutaneous fungal infections, intertrigo, dermatophytosis.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Inhibits 14α-demethylase, blocking ergosterol synthesis and disrupting fungal cell membrane permeability and function.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: Apply topically to clean, dry affected areas twice daily for 2-4 weeks. Ensure adequate skin hygiene.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, male infertility (induction of spermatogenesis), cryptorchidism.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Luteinizing Hormone (LH) receptor agonist that stimulates Leydig cells in the testes to synthesize and secrete endogenous testosterone.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 1500 IU to 5000 IU SC/IM 2-3 times per week. Commonly co-administered to maintain intratesticular testosterone levels during gonadotropin therapy or hormone protocols.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Estrogen receptor-mediated endocrinopathies, hormone replacement therapy, systemic estrogen management.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Binds to nuclear estrogen receptors (ERα and ERβ) to regulate target gene expression, gonadotropin negative feedback, and tissue metabolic homeostasis.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: Dose individualized according to serum laboratory monitoring. Monitor lipid profiles, blood pressure, and hepatic function.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Progestogenic hormonal management, suppression of hormone-dependent tissue growth, chronic pelvic pain reduction.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Selective progestin with potent systemic and localized anti-estrogenic activity; suppresses ovarian estradiol production and induces endometrial/target tissue atrophy.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 2 mg daily taken continuously at the same time each day. Discontinuation or missed doses can trigger breakthrough bleeding.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE) treatment/prophylaxis, post-surgical thromboprophylaxis.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Direct, reversible inhibitor of free and clot-bound Factor Xa, suppressing thrombin generation and fibrin clot formation without requiring antithrombin III.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 2.5 mg to 5 mg orally BID depending on renal clearance and clinical indication. Lower risk of major GI bleeding relative to warfarin.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Advanced/metastatic prostate cancer, extended 3-month depot androgen deprivation therapy (ADT).
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Potent long-acting GnRH receptor agonist; continuous exposure leads to pituitary desensitization, suppression of LH/FSH secretion, and reduction of serum testosterone to castrate levels (<50 ng/dL).
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 11.25 mg SC/IM injection administered every 12 weeks. Monitor serum testosterone and serum PSA response periodically.

brand_formulary.clinical_indications: Advanced prostate cancer (1-month depot ADT), hormone-sensitive tumor management.
brand_formulary.mechanism_of_action: Continuous GnRH receptor stimulation causing pituitary receptor downregulation and suppression of testicular androgen synthesis.
brand_formulary.dosing_and_clinical_pearls: 3.75 mg SC/IM injection monthly. Co-administer an anti-androgen for the first 2-4 weeks to mitigate testosterone surge/flare symptoms.
